notes: Fair, solvable puzzle. Each decoy fails exactly one need, which makes it a clean elimination. The peanut allergy is the most indirect clue ('satay incident 2.0' plus Mina reading sauces); a player has to infer peanuts from satay. That seems fair at this stage of the campaign, but a less experienced player might miss it and fall for Starboard, since that peanut detail sits late in its second review. Spindrift's second review packs veg page, no fryer and lightness into one paragraph, which makes the answer fairly visible once you get to it. Mooring Post being one tier over is a good near-miss (2 stars). No contradictions found.
